Replace current data from a Black Hole ZIP backup

The ZIP contains website logins, cookies, local storage, browsing data, settings, and rules. Anyone with the file may be able to access your accounts. Store it somewhere protected. Black Hole restarts once to create a consistent backup.

At least one profile uses biometric protection. After choosing a location, strong biometric authentication is required. Protected profile data is written readable into the ZIP; the ZIP itself is not biometrically protected or encrypted. Anyone with the file can read its contents. Black Hole restarts once to create a consistent backup.
Replace all Black Hole data?
